data.name: Juwaina
data.gender_notes: Juwaina is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Jawwana', meaning 'to caress' or 'to be gentle'. Juwaina is a name of Arabic origin, meaning 'gentle' or 'delicate'. The name Juwaina carries the meaning “Gentle, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Juwaina usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the delicate beauty and strength found in nature and within oneself.
data.etymology: Juwaina belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Delicate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Juwaina total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: جوينة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم جوينة هو اسم مؤنث يعود إلى الجذر اللغوي 'ج-و-ن' الذي يعني الجمال وال حسن. وقد ورد في بعض المراجع اللغوية العربية أن جوينة تعني الفتاة الجميلة أو الحسنة. ويشير بعض المفسرين إلى أن الاسم قد يكون له علاقة بالجنة أو الجنة النعيم، ولكن هذا ليس له أساس قوي في القرآن أو السنة النبوية.

in_urdu.name: جوینہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: جوینہ ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے جذر 'ج-و-ن' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورتی اور حسن۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں اس نام کا استعمال روایتی ہے اور یہ نام اچھے اخلاق اور خوبصورتی کی علامت سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जुवैना
in_hindi.long_meaning: जुवैना एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा के मूल 'ज-व-न' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है सुंदरता और अच्छाई। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम का उपयोग पारंपरिक है और यह नाम अच्छे चरित्र और सुंदरता का प्रतीक माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: جوینه
in_pashto.long_meaning: جوینه یو مونث نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې د 'ج-و-ن' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چی معنی یی ښایسته او ښځینه ده. په افغان او پښتون دود کې ددی نوم استعمال روایتی دی او دا نوم د ښایست او نیکۍ نښه ګڼل کیږي.

in_english.name: Juwaina
in_english.long_meaning: Juwaina is a feminine name derived from the Arabic root 'ج-و-ن' (j-w-n), meaning beauty and goodness. Etymologically, it relates to concepts of beauty and moral excellence. While not directly mentioned in the Quran, the root 'ج-و-ن' is associated with positive attributes. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing desirable personality traits such as kindness, beauty, and righteousness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Juwaina carries a deep-rooted cultural significance, particularly in the Arab world. It echoes values of kindness, gentleness, and care, which are greatly cherished and emphasized in Islamic teachings and traditions. Naming a child Juwaina conveys a message of nurturing and caring, reflecting the importance of treating those around us with love and compassion.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Juwaina also holds significant spiritual meaning, reminding us of the gentle yet powerful nature of God. Islamic teachings emphasize that God is not only the Creator of all things but also the most Compassionate (Rahman) and Merciful (Rahim). The name gently cradles this meaning, embodying the essence of God's love and care for His creation. Additionally, the gentle nature of Juwaina can serve as a reminder for Muslims to strive for gentle character traits and to cultivate a gentle and compassionate spirit in their own lives.
